interface Labeled<T extends { value: number }> extends T {
  label: string;
}
interface FromObject<T extends object> extends T {}
interface FromEmpty<T extends {}> extends T {}
interface FromOther<T extends { a: number }, U extends T> extends U {}
interface WithObject<T extends { a: number }> extends T, Object {}
interface Redeclared<T extends { value: number }> extends T {
  value: number;
}
interface SelfConstrained<T extends { a: T }> extends T {}
interface Box {
  v: number;
}
interface Holder<T extends Box> {
  t: T;
}
interface Extended<T extends Box> extends Holder<T> {
  extra: string;
}
const extended: Extended<Box> = { t: { v: 1 }, extra: 'x' };
console.log(extended.t.v, extended.extra);
